name: util.inspect of an Error
source:
import { inspect } from 'node:util'; function main(): void {   const e = new Error('boom');   const s = inspect(e);   console.log(s.split('
')[0]);   console.log(s.split('
').slice(1).every((l: string) => l.startsWith('    at ')));   console.log(String(e.stack).split('
')[0]);   console.log(inspect(new TypeError('t')).split('
')[0]); }
